notes.title: NEW MODE! NO JUMP MODE
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/PDdPj9Q/a880c8cc-3ec7-4a8c-a2f6-eaebe5ddbbe0.jpg[/img]

No jump mode is a mode where you can't jump in any way and you have to make it to the end. Can you?

- Fixed bugs.
- Fixed megaball skin that doesn't shows up.

notes.title: Hallowen Special (Free DLC)
notes.notes:
With the latest update you will find the following new features.
- Venture into the new Hallowen-themed path full of scary dangers, obstacles and waterfalls of blood. Unlock exclusive skins such as the eye and super pumpkin.
- New completion goals. Now by completing the game several times you can unlock brand new exclusive skins. 
_ An all-new Hallowen-themed menu.
